action_items: Fix DAP 320px overflow to satisfy F06 zero-overflow matrix requirement.
Resolve React key warning in OwnerMarkup list rendering paths (F08 runtime cleanliness).
Decide whether history detail should display full canonical run id with 'cr-' prefix for strict F07 evidence readability.

Runtime React key warnings indicate unstable or duplicate keys in rendered prototype loops; this risks rerender inconsistencies and should be fixed before further fidelity sign-off.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (core F02/F03/F04/F05/F07 flows pass; F06(320 overflow) and F08(runtime warning) fail)

rca of the issue: RCA-1 (F06 overflow): At 320px, DAP layout still enforces combined nav/body minimum width behavior, producing horizontal scroll (344px content width).
